notes.title: RELEASE DAY!
notes.notes:
HELLO ALL!

First of all, we here at Whiteshadow Games are SO happy to be releasing our first game to the world. We have spent nearly a whole year perfecting this game to the best of our ability and are proud of what it's become. From concept art to 3D Modelling to coding the game together it's been one hell of a journey and we sincerely hope you enjoy the outcome. 

However,with that being said this is not the end of the road for us. We have so many ideas and areas of the game we are continuously looking to explore and add to so you can expect plenty of updates in the future. This is something we are incredibly proud of and we aren't going to let it rust and die off now it's out there.

By Spring we hope to have a roadmap for the year where we will have an outline of what's to come. Future updates and news will be displayed here so keep an eye out on that front.

Once again, we seriously hope you enjoy Hectic Highways, because through all the late nights and hard work we've massively enjoyed making it.
